citation.short_title: Melvin-Koushki, The New Brethren of Purity (2025)

content: The paper says that in circa 1426, in the dedicatory preface of the lengthy Arabic lettrist Sharḥ al-Basmala (unedited), Ibn Turka fashions Ulugh Beg the ultimate philosopher-king and sultan-scientist, the Archytas of the age, and claims the Samarkand Observatory as a realisation of the New Brethren's project; Qāżīzāda Rūmī's letter of thanks is extant. It says Qāżīzāda's friendship with Ibn Turka dated from childhood.
